label: Figure 8.9: A minimum price in the market for milk
alt: Supply and demand for milk with a price floor P min above equilibrium, showing quantity demanded Q1, equilibrium Qe and quantity supplied Q2 with an excess supply bracket.
caption: The free-market equilibrium for milk is at P<sub>e</sub> = $12 and Q<sub>e</sub> = 50 (million litres). A minimum price P<sub>min</sub> = $18 is set above it. At that price consumers buy only Q<sub>1</sub> = 30 but farmers supply Q<sub>2</sub> = 80, so there is excess supply (a surplus) of 50 million litres.
